q1: SELECT DISTINCT AUTHOR_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS WHERE AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID ORDER BY ID
q2: SELECT DISTINCT V1.AUTHOR_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS AS V1, VIEWS AS V2 WHERE V1.AUTHOR_ID = V2.VIEWER_ID AND V1.ARTICLE_ID = V2.ARTICLE_ID ORDER BY V1.AUTHOR_ID

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects distinct author IDs where the author ID is equal to the viewer ID, while Q2 selects distinct author IDs where there exists another view record with the same article ID and a different viewer ID.
